newsitem.title: NORWAY: New Norway T-bill gets highest yield of 4.20 pct.
newsitem.headline: New Norway T-bill gets highest yield of 4.20 pct.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, said on Monday the auction of the new 12-month treasury bill, SS48, produced a highest yield of 4.20 percent.
The lowest yield at the ordinary auction was 4.09 percent and the weighted average was 4.16 percent. Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 27 percent allotment.
The bank announced the T-bill last Thursday at 5.5 billion crowns, with 500 million crowns reserved for the central bank.
The T-bill has a nominal interest rate of 4.0 percent and matures on June 17, 1998.
